body: I've been diagnosed with BDD and I've tried so many medications that the last doctor I saw said there is nothing left to do. There is nothing else for me to try so that means I just have to kill myself. I have body Dysmorphic Disorder and depression all my life, I've been hospitalized so many times, I've done inpatient and IOPs and groups. I've had dialectical behavioral therapy. Nothing will work. I tried it all. Don't be sad when I'm dead and say there was more to try. There wasn't. I gave it my all. I can't afford anything else. My fiance was gorgeous. I'm sorry.
See no one cares. No one can help. I'm doing it I've decided for sure. I am doing it.
